title: Colombo National Museum panel on Polonnaruwa coinage and Dharmasokadeva copper issue
author_or_institution: Colombo National Museum / Department of National Museums, Sri Lanka
author_institution: Department of National Museums, Sri Lanka
scope: Museum synthesis of Polonnaruwa royal coinage, metal composition, denominations, named rulers and foreign coin circulation
limitations: Modern museum synthesis; useful for field identification and historiographic framing but not sufficient alone for causal claims about economic collapse.

title: History of Currency in Sri Lanka
scope: Institutional history of Sinhala Massa/Kahawanu coinage, ruler names, copper transition and foreign coin circulation during Polonnaruwa
limitations: Institutional public-history synthesis rather than a specialist causal economic study; it documents coinage but does not establish monetary debasement as a cause of political collapse.

title: The Decline of Polonnaruva and the Rise of Dambadeniya, circa 1180-1270 A.D.
author_or_institution: Amaradasa Liyanagamage / SOAS University of London
scope: Specialist study of the political and economic disintegration after Parakramabahu I, including discussion of coinage debasement and rival interpretations of its meaning
limitations: Older doctoral synthesis; valuable because it directly tests the causal proposition, but its monetary discussion relies partly on earlier numismatic scholarship and should not be read as econometric proof.

title: Ceylon Coins and Currency
scope: Foundational numismatic catalogue and analysis of medieval Lankan coinage, including precious-metal and base-metal issues
limitations: Foundational but century-old numismatic synthesis; compositional and chronological claims should be checked against later specialist work where available.
